_README: Template for POST /v2/agent. Keys starting with an underscore are removed before sending. Structure follows Bolna's AGENTS.md (pipelines is an array of arrays). Bolna requires `language` (plain ISO code, e.g. hi, never hi-IN) in the sarvam synthesizer provider_config. The transcriber extras are UNVERIFIED guesses: if Bolna rejects them it prints its exact error, then adjust, or create the agent in the dashboard and set SUPPLIER_AGENT_ID. Change 'plivo' to 'twilio' if that is your telephony provider.

agent_config.agent_welcome_message: Namaste! Main {business_name} ki taraf se ek automated assistant bol raha hoon. Kya aapse kuch saaman ka bhaav pooch sakta hoon?
